text:
Anya: Quick design review — updated autoscale panel is in the design file. Main ask: feedback on visual hierarchy between Min/Max, Burst, GPU pool picker, and the SLO slider. I sketched two options: stacked controls vs. compact row. Screenshot attached in Figma (see link in PR). Samir: Stack feels heavy. I think Max should be more visually prominent than Min — most customers think about upper bounds. Make Min lighter and secondary. Maria: Engineering constraint: the UI needs to map 1:1 to API fields we expose: min_instances, max_instances, burst_capacity, slo_target. If we hide burst behind a menu it becomes harder to show cost estimates up front. Kevin: Accessibility nits: add explicit labels and aria-describedby for the SLO slider and the burst button. For the slider use aria-label="SLO target percentage" and reference a hidden description element explaining tradeoffs. Ensure keyboard support for burst toggle. Jen: Copy tweak: instead of just "Burst" suggest "Burst capacity (short-lived)" or "Burst (temporary)" — reduces confusion about whether burst is persistent. Also add microcopy under SLO slider: "Lower SLO = lower cost, higher latency risk". Samir: Also consider a tiny inline cost delta next to Min/Max when you change values e.g., "+3.2% cost" — helps users make tradeoffs without opening the cost modal. Anya: Pool picker decision — dropdown vs modal? We have customers with 30+ pools; dropdown gets unwieldy. Maria: Strong +1 for searchable modal with filter chips (region, GPU type, priority). Modal lets us show CPU/GPU metrics and expected latency. Add an "Auto-select best pool" toggle that routes by cost/latency. Kevin: Modal needs role=dialog and focus trap. For pool choice cards ensure aria-pressed state and keyboard-selectable rows. Also add a short accessible label for the auto-select toggle. Anya: @Maria can you add the API field mapping to the PR spec? @Kevin can you draft a short accessibility checklist we can attach to the design? Maria: Will add mappings and a tiny table in the PR. Quick example snippet for the SLO slider: ```
Lower SLO reduces resource allocation but increases chance of throttled requests.
``` Kevin: Nice. Small extra: the range needs an announcer/live region update so screen readers get value changes e.g., aria-live="polite" on a sibling element that prints the percent. Jen: I'm updating microcopy and the small cost-lift copy. One more copy ask: for burst tooltip use "Burst capacity: temporary extra instances that scale down automatically". Samir: I'll mock a compact dual-stepper for Min/Max to fit tight side panels and post two variants (inline vs stacked). :thumbsup: deploy-bot: Design review created — DR-3421 — autoscale control hierarchy and accessibility checklist. Link: https://jira/redwood/DR-3421 Anya: Thanks all — if there are no blockers I'll merge the branch tonight and follow up with a short playbook for SRE and support to understand behavior of burst and auto-select.
